applicable_statute_sections: IT Act Section 66D (cheating by personation); BNS cheating and forgery sections; BNS stalking provisions (replacing former IPC 354D); BNS criminal intimidation sections where threats exist. Note: IT Act Section 66A is struck down (unconstitutional, Shreya Singhal v. Union of India, 2015) and must never be cited as applicable.
procedure_where_to_go: Report the fake profile to the platform directly for urgent takedown. File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in. If clients/contacts were defrauded, notify them directly. ALSO: File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in. Approach the local police station to file an FIR under the relevant BNS stalking/harassment/intimidation sections.

category: Data Breach / Company Data Leak + Financial Cyber Fraud (OTP/UPI/Phishing/Card)
user_input: Recently, after a data breach at an insurance company, my card details were leaked and my entire savings was fraudulently charged. I'm really worried.
applicable_statute_sections: IT Act Section 43A (compensation for negligence in protecting sensitive data); DPDPA 2023 (if it qualifies as a data-fiduciary breach); IT Act Section 66C (identity theft); IT Act Section 66D (cheating by personation using a computer resource); BNS cheating provisions where applicable
procedure_where_to_go: File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in. Once DPDPA grievance mechanisms/Data Protection Board are operational, a complaint can also be filed there against the data fiduciary. Also raise the issue directly with the organization's grievance/data protection officer. ALSO: Call the 1930 cyber fraud helpline IMMEDIATELY to attempt a transaction freeze. File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in with transaction details/screenshots. Inform your bank's fraud department and block the affected card/UPI ID right away.

category: Doxxing / Unauthorized Sharing of Personal Info + Online Defamation
user_input: Hi, someone posted my personal address online along with false accusations meant to damage my reputation. I'm really worried.
applicable_statute_sections: IT Act Section 66E (privacy violation); BNS criminal intimidation sections if accompanied by threats; BNS defamation sections (both civil and criminal routes may apply)
procedure_where_to_go: Report at cybercrime.gov.in; request platform takedown of the posted information; file an FIR at the local cyber cell if threats accompany the exposure. ALSO: You can pursue a civil defamation suit for damages, or file a criminal complaint at the local police station/cybercrime.gov.in. Platform takedown can also be requested via the grievance officer under IT Rules 2021.

category: Ransomware / Extortion Malware + Business Email Compromise / Corporate Fraud
user_input: Hi, our company's finance systems were hit by ransomware right after a fraudulent email compromised an employee's account. Can you help me understand my options?
